predicate.condition: One predicate succeeded in the maintainer-reported live Actions job at the pinned revision using Copilot-Integration-Id: agentic-workflows; logs were not independently retrieved. This does not establish choice/score, general account availability or credential eligibility.

conversation_input.condition: Shared input is a text string or an ordered array of messages, function calls, custom tool calls and outputs. Match each tool output to its call with call_id. Developer/system messages accept input text only; system messages are treated as developer messages. Assistant messages accept output text or refusals. Tool outputs accept text and images. Files, audio and item references are unsupported.

image_input.condition: Images may use inline base64 data URLs or publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URLs, not file_id. User messages may combine input_text and input_image. Predicate, choice and score question instructions may be a nonempty array of input_text/input_image parts without a message wrapper or role; question images share the request's image limits with shared input.

json_input.condition: input_json content parts carry a JSON object or array in data and are supported only in user-message content. JSON keys inside data do not create messages or fetch images; JSON input does not change the typed-answer response format.

prompt_cache_options.condition: At most four cache breakpoints may be written per request. Matching considers the latest 80 conversation breakpoints without a content-block lookback limit. ttl defaults to 30m, currently its only supported value. These SDK constraints are recorded only for native gpt-6-luna Decisions, not inherited by other model families or Copilot.

prompt_caching.condition: Cache reuse requires an identical shared-input prefix of at least 1,024 tokens; questions and question images are outside that prefix. An implicit breakpoint at the end of shared input is the default. prompt_cache_key partitions reuse; prompt_cache_breakpoint on shared text/image parts marks explicit boundaries. prompt_cache_options.mode=explicit disables the implicit boundary; without marked boundaries explicit mode does not cache. Breakpoints are unsupported in question instructions. Cache-read and cache-write token counts are already included in usage.input_tokens.

typed_questions.condition: 1–400 predicate, choice or score questions; score questions use 2–10 ordered levels; answers retain question order.
